technical-summary: The Radiance lab profiler no longer launches helpers and the engine itself or kills r3_moe_worker by name. fn-helper.sh (global pgrep/pkill and shared-memory unlink, manifest argument mismatch with fn-profile.sh, grep || true masking failure) is deleted. fn-profile.sh now starts the native owner (bc-serve serve NAME with a native YAML), attaches rocprofv3 by PID to the engine and helper processes named in the session record, sends one request, and ends the session only through bc-serve stop; profiler, request and stop failures exit nonzero. fn-profile-compare.py is unchanged. Tests: tools/tests/lab/test_fn_profile_native.py.
user-summary-candidate: Kernel profiling of the Radiance helper now runs through the native serving owner and can no longer kill another session's helper processes.
